description: This file contains helper functions for file operations, including path retrieval, file creation, and pattern checking, used in testing within the starboard/nplb namespace.

classes.name: ScopedRandomFile
classes.description: Utility class for creating temporary files with random content for testing purposes.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile::MakeRandomFilename
methods.description: Generates a unique filename using a random number.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile::ExpectPattern
methods.description: Checks if the buffer matches a specific pattern based on offset.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile::MakeRandomFilePath
methods.description: Creates a full path for a temporary random file.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile::MakeRandomFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with specified length filled with pattern data.
